actual.status: PROVED AS A FINITE TYPE-I FAITHFUL-GIBBS TOPOLOGY LEMMA; A GENERAL W-STAR EXTENSION AND UNIFORM M_0/M_1 FOR THE STRUCTURED TRUNCATED EVOLUTION ARE OPEN

actual.canonical_reconstruction: The map V[F]_0=(sqrt(lambda_+)[F]_+,sqrt(lambda_-)[F]_-) is an isometry from H_0 onto the closed cyclic common-word subspace K of H_+ direct-sum H_-. Because the full common analytic word algebra contains products, star and both real shift orientations, K reduces the direct-sum word representation and real-time group. Periodic OS reconstruction uniqueness therefore identifies the mixture dynamics with this restriction.
actual.inputs: Fix beta>0 and the two EXP-000790 parity-related path laws mu_(beta,+/-) on the same loop configuration space. Let 0<lambda_+,lambda_-<1 with lambda_++lambda_-=1 and mu_0=lambda_+mu_++lambda_-mu_-. Use the same full positive-time cylinder module D_+, common to both phases, together with the sharp-time algebra S_conf and formal analytic word/time-shift operations already verified in EXP-000790.
actual.intertwiners: J_sigma=lambda_sigma^(-1/2)P_sigma V has dense range, norm at most lambda_sigma^(-1/2), and intertwines every common analytic word and the reconstructed real-time groups. T_sigma=J_sigma^*J_sigma lies in M_0 prime, is positive, obeys T_sigma<=lambda_sigma^(-1)I and lambda_+T_++lambda_-T_-=I.
actual.normal_kms_states: On the support-reduced mixture GNS W-star algebra, psi_sigma(X)=<Omega_0,T_sigma X Omega_0> is a normal beta-KMS state for the single mixture group alpha_0 and reproduces the sigma Matsubara and real-time word functions. The two states remain distinct and parity-related through S_conf. For lambda_+=lambda_-=1/2 the mixture state is parity invariant.
actual.reflection_form: For sigma in {+,-,0}, q_sigma(F,G)=int conjugate(F(Theta omega))G(omega)dmu_sigma. Linearity gives q_0=lambda_+q_++lambda_-q_- and q_sigma(F,F)<=lambda_sigma^(-1)q_0(F,F).
actual.scope: The envelope is fixed-beta and is defined from the chosen DLR phase pair and full common OS word kernel. It is not a finite-volume Hamiltonian thermodynamic limit, a beta-independent or representation-independent quasi-local C-star dynamics, or a ground-state system.
actual.strongstar_topology: The support-reduced mixture KMS vector is cyclic and separating. On norm-bounded sets, ||X||_(#,0)^2=psi_0(X^*X)+psi_0(XX^*) metrizes strong-star. Thus direct two-sided mixture-L2 Cauchy is the exact fixed-beta topology target for later Hamiltonian exhaustion identification.

rows.actual: No single-rung site influence recurrence with a neighbor coefficient epsilon(delta) tending to zero can hold uniformly over the source observable. A surviving bond estimate must retain a Weyl-frequency or analytic-rung profile.
rows.name: single rung scope

actual.direct_cauchy_criterion: For bounded nets, direct Cauchy of both D and delta-D in the mixture Duhamel seminorm implies two-sided mixture-L2 and hence strong-star Cauchy by the arithmetic/logarithmic-mean inequality from R-167 v1.2. Product closure then uses joint strong-star continuity on bounded sets.
actual.missing_identification: Finite-volume Hamiltonian-evolved characters do not yet have a canonical exhaustion-independent embedding into the OS mixture envelope, their generator is not yet identified with the exact local polynomial derivation there, and the symmetric mixture is not proved to be the periodic zero-source finite-volume limit. Momentum and a full canonical Weyl algebra are also not reconstructed.
actual.valid_fixed_beta_word_class: The countable orbit-word span generated by rational-time translates of rational finite-support S_conf characters is strong-dense in the mixture OS W-star envelope.
